## Open

### F-276 — A test that set the slow margin alone also got the reporting threshold

> _2026-09-26 · core/blong-lib · open_

CI failed `withProgress › warns when a step finishes past the slow margin` with `2 !== 1`, the
second assertion seeing a "still running" line where it expected "took". The test passed
`slowMs: 10` and `intervalMs: 10_000` over a 60ms step, written as if the reporting threshold were
independent of the margin; the implementation defaults `thresholdMs` to `slowMs` on purpose — a step
slow enough to warn about is slow enough to report on while it runs — so the step reported at 10ms
as well as at completion. Fix: the test states `thresholdMs: 10_000`, out of the step's reach, to
isolate the completion line, and a new test pins the default so the pairing is asserted rather than
assumed. Lesson: when a unit test sets one of a pair of defaults, it must state the other, or a
later pairing silently re-interprets the test.
